messages:
maria: Postmortem posted for outage yesterday. We need discrete owners and short timelines for: runbook triage polish, escalation phone/SMS flow, and autoscale + fallback rules. Please claim by EOD.

liam: I can take the autoscale + fallback work. Plan: benchmark maxReplicas 12/24/48, add a cheap-variant fallback when queue_depth > 350, and emit a metric when fallback is active. ETA: 2026-04-08. Will open draft PR and link perf runs.

tessa: I'll handle runbook triage edits. Intend to add a 5-minute checklist, explicit commands with expected outputs, and a one-line "when to escalate" note. ETA: 2026-03-28.

alex.m: adding notes on autoscaler testing: in staging we saw sustained queue depth spikes that kept HPA from scaling fast enough due to cooldown settings. I'll try lowering stabilizationWindowSeconds and adding a queue-length-based scaler. Also will test with worker::burst=true traffic. ETA aligned with liam.

priya: I'll own the escalation playbook. Will define paging thresholds (3m, 10m, 20m), contact matrix (on-call -> infra SRE -> platform lead -> account manager), and include SMS fallback when Slack is degraded. ETA: 2026-04-12.

maria: good. liam/tessa/priya - pls add your initial PR/issue links to the action tracker by EOD and set the milestone to "pm12456-followups".

liam: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/ops/pull/501 (autoscale tests, WIP). Perf dashboard: grafana.company/r/autoscale-tests

tessa: dropping the exact commands I want in the runbook under "first 5 minutes":

# control-plane
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide
kubectl -n inference top pods -n inference | grep router
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/inference-router -c router --since=5m | grep -Ei "backpressure|throttle|error"

# queue + workers
curl -s http://router.internal/metrics | grep queue_depth
ssh ops@gpu-node-5 "tail -n 200 /var/log/inference/worker.log | grep -Ei 'kvmiss|hotshard|reconnect'"

# emergency manual scale
kubectl -n inference scale deployment inference-worker --replicas=16

liam: nice. I'll include a short perf expected-output doc: e.g., HPA desired > current for 2 cycles -> issue manual scale, router logs show "backpressure: true" when queue_depth > 300.

priya: escalation specifics: page infra SRE at 3m if queue_depth > 250 and error-rate > 1%. Page account manager at 20m if customer-visible errors > 0. I'll include phone numbers and the cloud ops pager escalation (rotation table).

maria: ownership summary here for tracker: liam (autoscale + fallback, 2026-04-08), tessa (runbook triage edits, 2026-03-28), priya (escalation playbook, 2026-04-12), alex.m (HPA tuning assistance, 2026-04-05). I'll run a 30m sync Thursday 14:00 UTC.

tessa: quick UI note: I'll add a prominent "on-call: run these commands within 5 minutes" banner at the top of the runbook and wire it into the runbook index.

liam: also proposing an alert change: split queue-depth into two alerts: warning at 200, critical at 300 and add a synthetic heartbeat that checks model-variant fallback activity.

alex.m: agree. I'll add the synthetic traffic job to the perf suite so we can validate scale curves.

priya: for escalation matrix I'll add a decision tree image and short templates for Slack messages to send to customers if we hit 20+ minutes.

maria: recurrence note: this is similar to two prior incidents (tags: queue-backpressure) in the last 180 days. After these PRs land, we should add a recurring monthly incident-pattern review to the playbook (owner: platform lead).

ops-bot: linked PM issue pm#12456 to action-tracker: https://github.com/redwood/pm/issues/12456

tessa: posting a gist with example grep outputs and small explanation: https://gist.github.com/tessa/incident-outputs-2026

liam: perf runs scheduled for 2026-04-06 in staging. Will post results in PR and tag for review.

maria: thanks all. Please update your issue/PR status before the Thursday sync. We'll run two simulated incidents in staging the week after merge to validate TLs and playbook clarity. Closing comments but keeping thread for updates.
